task: Check out Text Embeddings Inference in Hugging face's Doc to summarise the strengths of the toolkit.
answer: Text Embeddings Inference (TEI) is a comprehensive toolkit for efficient deployment and serving of open source text embeddings models. Its strengths are: (1) Streamlined Deployment - no model graph compilation step needed; (2) Efficient Resource Utilization - small Docker images and rapid boot times enabling true serverless capabilities; (3) Dynamic Batching - token-based dynamic batching optimizes resource utilization during inference; (4) Optimized Inference - leverages Flash Attention, Candle, and cuBLASLt via optimized transformers code; (5) Safetensors weight loading for faster boot times; (6) Production-Ready - supports distributed tracing through OpenTelemetry and exports Prometheus metrics. It also enables high-performance extraction for the most popular models including FlagEmbedding, Ember, GTE, and E5, and supports multiple hardware backends (CPU, Metal, GPU, Intel, AMD ROCm, AWS Trainium/Inferentia, Google Cloud).
